doc.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Interviewer's closing question on Hinton and Cheatham stories
summary: Mary Kopcza asks for stories about musicians mentioned earlier.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Well thank you very much for conversing with us. Mary do you have another question you might ask?

I’m just off on this sideline. John you were talking about some of the people that had great stories that we talked to. And you mentioned Milt Hinton and Doc Cheatham. I take it that you know some of those stories? Do you? Would you share any of them?
